title: Every box is unchecked
description: Instagram square: a giant amber unchecked verification box — the site’s central visual argument.
alt_text: Square dark card titled “Every allegation carries a verification box.” A giant empty amber square dominates the center. Below, in amber italics: Every box is unchecked. Then: no charge, no court finding, no independent verification — in any direction, as of Jul 11 2026. Allegations as allegations. Denials as denials.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Social card for The Platner Record documentation site. Restrained archival styling; figures from official Maine SOS results and the site’s sourced ledgers. Attribution metadata is also embedded in the PNG as tEXt chunks (Author, Copyright, Title, Description).
